name: finds an exact plan with the fewest purchases and reconstructs it
returns a valid minimum plan without imposing an unspecified tie break
input: two possible ways to fill target 12
test:
result = min_exact_purchase_plan([2, 4, 6, 10], 12)
assert result['minimum_count'] == 2
assert result['items'] == sorted(result['items'])
assert len(result['items']) == result['minimum_count']
assert sum(result['items']) == 12
assert all(item in {2, 4, 6, 10} for item in result['items'])
